_about: Core validation rule library (Phase 1, US v3.2.2 profile). Rules are modelled on the kinds of checks in public agency validation criteria; IDs are the app's own and do not reproduce any agency's numbering. Severity follows the US high/medium/low convention: any High finding means the sequence would likely be technically rejected.

rules.title: Every leaf must reference a file that exists
rules.explain: The backbone points to a document that is no longer in the project's library, so the file would be missing from the package.
rules.fix: Remove the leaf or place a document that exists.

rules.title: No two leaves in a sequence may point to the same file path
rules.explain: Two leaves resolve to the same folder and file name. One file would overwrite the other in the package.
rules.fix: Give one of the documents a distinct file name, or remove the duplicate leaf.

rules.title: Every leaf needs a title
rules.explain: The leaf title is what the reviewer sees in the agency viewer. An empty title makes the document unidentifiable.
rules.fix: Enter a descriptive leaf title in the properties panel.

rules.title: Leaf title should not be the file name
rules.explain: Titles like 'qos_v3_final.pdf' are unhelpful to reviewers and look unprofessional.
rules.fix: Use a readable title, normally the CTD heading or the study title.

rules.title: Regional administrative metadata must be complete
rules.explain: The US regional XML needs applicant, application number, submission type, sub-type and sequence number. Missing values make the sequence unprocessable.
rules.fix: Complete the fields in Module 1 → Regional metadata.

rules.title: Repeatable sections need their attributes
rules.explain: 3.2.S needs substance and manufacturer attributes; 3.2.P needs product name, dosage form and manufacturer. Without them the agency cannot tell repeated sections apart.
rules.fix: Fill the attributes in Project settings → Repeatable sections.

rules.title: File names use lowercase letters, digits and hyphens only
rules.explain: eCTD file names must be lowercase and limited to a-z, 0-9 and hyphen, with a single '.pdf' extension. Spaces, capitals and underscores break the rule.
rules.fix: Rename the file, e.g. 'batch-analyses.pdf'.

rules.title: File names should be 64 characters or fewer
rules.explain: Long file names push folder paths past system limits and are hard to read.
rules.fix: Shorten the file name.

rules.title: Full path should be 180 characters or fewer
rules.explain: The path from the sequence folder to the file is too long and may fail on some systems.
rules.fix: Shorten the file name or repeatable-section folder names.

rules.title: Document is placed under the wrong heading
rules.explain: The document's content belongs to a different CTD section from the node it was placed in. Reviewers will not find it where they expect.
rules.fix: Drag the document to the heading shown in its properties.

rules.title: Heading not used in eCTD
rules.explain: 2.1 (CTD table of contents) is not submitted in eCTD: the backbone is the table of contents.
rules.fix: Remove the leaf from 2.1.

rules.title: PDF version must be 1.4 to 1.7 (or PDF/A-1, PDF/A-2)
rules.explain: Older or newer PDF versions are outside the accepted range for US eCTD.
rules.fix: Re-save the PDF at version 1.7.

rules.title: No security settings or passwords
rules.explain: Secured PDFs cannot be opened, copied or annotated by reviewers.
rules.fix: Remove the document security.

rules.title: All fonts must be embedded
rules.explain: Non-embedded fonts can render incorrectly on the reviewer's machine.
rules.fix: Re-render the PDF with all fonts embedded.

rules.title: Documents of 5 pages or more need bookmarks
rules.explain: Long documents without bookmarks are hard to navigate in review.
rules.fix: Add bookmarks (auto-bookmark from headings).

rules.title: Hyperlinks must resolve
rules.explain: One or more hyperlinks point to a target that is not in the dossier's current view.
rules.fix: Place the target document, or relink the hyperlinks.

rules.title: PDF text must be searchable
rules.explain: Scanned image-only PDFs cannot be searched or copied.
rules.fix: Run OCR or produce the PDF from the source document.

rules.title: Sequence numbers are four digits, unique and in order
rules.explain: Each sequence must have a unique four-digit number, higher than the previous one.
rules.fix: Renumber the sequence.

rules.title: Replace, append and delete need a valid target
rules.explain: The leaf points to an earlier leaf that does not exist, is no longer current, or sits in an earlier sequence that was not submitted.
rules.fix: Choose a current leaf from an earlier published sequence as the target.

rules.title: Lifecycle target must be under the same heading
rules.explain: A replace, append or delete must act on a leaf in the same CTD heading (and the same repeatable section).
rules.fix: Place the new document in the same heading as the leaf it replaces.

rules.title: The first sequence may only use 'new'
rules.explain: There is nothing to replace, append or delete in the first sequence of an application.
rules.fix: Change the operation to 'new'.

rules.title: 'New' leaf duplicates a current leaf
rules.explain: A new leaf with the same title as a current leaf in the same heading usually means 'replace' was intended. The reviewer will now see two versions.
rules.fix: Change the operation to 'replace' and target the earlier leaf.

rules.title: A sequence cannot change after it is published
rules.explain: Published sequences are frozen. Changes need a new sequence.
rules.fix: Create a new sequence for the change.

rules.title: Form FDA 356h is required
rules.explain: Every submission to an NDA includes Form FDA 356h in Module 1.1.
rules.fix: Place the 356h form in 1.1.

rules.title: A cover letter is expected in 1.2
rules.explain: The cover letter tells the review division what the sequence contains and why.
rules.fix: Generate a cover letter in Module 1 and place it in 1.2.

rules.title: User fee coversheet expected for an original NDA
rules.explain: Form FDA 3397 accompanies an original application that is subject to a user fee.
rules.fix: Place Form FDA 3397 in 1.1.

rules.title: Patent information expected for an original NDA
rules.explain: Form FDA 3542a lists patents claiming the drug and is filed with the NDA in 1.3.5.1.
rules.fix: Place the patent information in 1.3.5.1.

rules.title: Debarment certification expected for an original NDA
rules.explain: The applicant certifies it did not use debarred persons, in 1.3.3.
rules.fix: Place the debarment certification in 1.3.3.

rules.title: Financial certification or disclosure expected
rules.explain: Clinical investigators' financial interests are certified or disclosed in 1.3.4.
rules.fix: Place Form FDA 3454/3455 in 1.3.4.

rules.title: Draft labeling expected for an original NDA
rules.explain: Draft prescribing information (1.14.1.3) and carton and container labels (1.14.1.1) are part of an original NDA.
rules.fix: Place both draft labeling documents.

rules.title: Field copy certification expected for an original NDA
rules.explain: Certifies that a field copy of Module 3 was sent to the local office.
rules.fix: Place the field copy certification in 1.3.2.

rules.title: ClinicalTrials.gov certification expected
rules.explain: Form FDA 3674 accompanies applications that contain clinical data.
rules.fix: Place Form FDA 3674 in 1.1.

rules.title: Environmental analysis expected
rules.explain: An environmental assessment or a claim of categorical exclusion goes in 1.12.14.
rules.fix: Place the environmental analysis in 1.12.14.

rules.title: Required heading is empty
rules.explain: This heading is expected for the chosen application type and submission, but has no document in the current view.
rules.fix: Place the matching document from the library.

rules.title: Document is too coarse
rules.explain: One file covers several CTD subsections. Each subsection should be its own document so it can be replaced alone later.
rules.fix: Remove the combined file and place the individual section documents.

rules.title: Document is too fine
rules.explain: The content is split finer than ICH granularity expects, which complicates lifecycle.
rules.fix: Use the single complete document for this heading.

rules.title: Study documents in Modules 4 and 5 need a study tagging file
rules.explain: In the US v3.2.2 profile, every study document in 4.2 and 5.3 is grouped by a study tagging file (STF) that names the study and tags each file's role. Untagged files appear loose in the reviewer's study view.
rules.fix: Give the leaf a study ID and file tag (properties panel), or use 'Tag studies from documents'.

rules.title: File tag must be a valid value for the module
rules.explain: The STF file tag says what the file is (study report, synopsis, protocol…). Tags come from a controlled list and differ between Module 4 and Module 5.
rules.fix: Pick a file tag from the list.

rules.title: Study ID does not match the document
rules.explain: The study ID on the leaf differs from the study the document reports, so the file is grouped under the wrong study.
rules.fix: Use the study ID shown in the document title.
